Wording, code and bounds are right, and the correction is right: all three printings print an asterisk directly after the closing full stop, a footnote mark, and it is correctly taken out. The Summary is unfaithful in one point: the statement introduces the ways of presenting (the ones that Limits names) as members of a wider set of ways content can come; the Summary puts them after a colon as if they were the whole set, so an example list reads as complete. Fix: say that the wider set includes these.
